description: Decru's Storage Encryption Processor (SEP) is the primary cryptographic and key management engine for Decru DataFort products. Decru DataFort is a wire-speed storage security appliance. DataFort uses hardware-based encryption, authentication, secure access controls, and secure logging.

oes.name: Atmel AT90SC6464C Secure Microcontroller, Decru SW 2T.4
